moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Their duet 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK No. 1 single of all time, spending 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart.

source.l: Official Charts Company / BuzzJack Music Forum

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just became the longest-running UK No. 1 single EVER with 19 weeks at the top. Phenomenal.

angles.name: The New Reign
angles.copy: 19 weeks at No. 1! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean has officially shattered the UK chart record. What an achievement!
